products.name: Royal Double Cheeseburger
products.description: Ikki qavatli 100% mol go'shtidan tayyorlangan kotlet, eritilgan chedder pishlog'i, karamellangan piyoz, tuzlangan bodring va maxsus tutunli FLAME sousi.

products.name: Tandir Mol Go‘shtli Lavash
products.description: Yupqa qarsildoq lavash xamiri ichida shirali mol go'shti bo'laklari, yangi pomidor, bodring, qarsildoq kartoshka fri va sarimsoqli qaymoqli sous.

products.name: Smoky BBQ King Hotdog
products.description: Yumshoq brioche bulochkada dudlangan mol go'shti sosiskasi, qovurilgan piyoz halqalari, xantal, BBQ sousi va eritilgan pishloq.

products.name: Spicy Jalapeño Fire Burger
products.description: Achchiq ta'm shinavandalari uchun: olovda pishgan go'sht, jalapeño qalampiri, pepper jack pishlog'i va maxsus achchiq chili mayonez.

products.name: Pishloqli Tovuqli Lavash
products.description: Maxsus ziravorlarda marinadlangan tovuq filesi, ikki xil eritilgan pishloq, yangi sabzavotlar va firmenniy sous.

products.name: Double Cheese Chili Hotdog
products.description: Ikki barobar pishloqli sous, mol go'shtli qiyma chili, yangi ko'katlar va qarsildoq piyoz bilan boyitilgan premium hotdog.
